body:
## [3.54.0] - 2026-07-22

### Features

- Normalize repair order references for improved barcode handling
- Update PrintCopiesDialog to use default receipt copies
- Enhance Multipass payment flow with budget checks and card display logic
- enhance repair order handling with local cache synchronization

### Bug Fixes

- scope customer cache by active POS
- Cap dialog height and adjust layout for better usability on large screens
- Update silentRelogin method to return false instead of null
- improve Windows updater handoff diagnostics

### Other Changes

- Sync failed order diagnostics to Odoo
- Harden POS sync and cart editing
- Refactor Paytag self-order screens and components
